# Cross-language fixtures

`go_sessions/` is a real session store written by the **Go** implementation, kept
so the Python store can be tested against artefacts it did not produce.

It was generated by running the Go `store.Store` directly and appending one record
of each of the ten types, so every replay path is represented:

| Record | Present |
|---|---|
| `session_started` | yes (once from `Create`, once explicit) |
| `message_appended` | four, including a `tool_calls` message |
| `tool_result` | yes |
| `approval_decision` | yes |
| `checkpoint` | yes, with a file entry |
| `error` | yes |
| `cancel` | yes |
| `compact` | yes, with `original_messages` and `kept_messages` |
| `reset` | yes |
| `context_replaced` | yes |

`_memory.json` sits at the store root. A second session directory exists so the
`List` ordering and "not every session is loaded" paths are exercised.

The timestamps show Go's `RFC3339Nano` trimming: `12:00:01` has no fractional
part at all, while `12:00:00.123456789` keeps all nine digits. Directory modes are
`0700` and file modes `0600`.

Regenerate by building a small program against the Go module that calls
`store.New(root)` and `Store.Append`; nothing here is hand-written.
